## Design

### 2026-10-13 – I spent quite a while getting dimensions and designing what I wanted to build actually. I realised that it would be difficult to get a fully transparent 3D printed enclosure, so I will use a laser cut

**2h**

I spent quite a while getting dimensions and designing what I wanted to build actually. I realised that it would be difficult to get a fully transparent 3D printed enclosure, so I will use a laser cutter to cut out plastic acrylic and connected by 3D designed parts that will hold each place and part together.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/0b5a1de1836fbf7df8c2146111e52ef3540c06e279cbaf0da8a3293c29651fc1.png)
The dimensions are 102.5 x 83 mm.

On top of that. I am probably going to 3D design keycaps.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/pYiuxHwsnPP3tNULfelu922LcuxvhBQz/ddac165726aeb0e7c9f055514a50dae888f7932d9e171393003012037638a8f5.png)
